name: Laughing Sister's Hair
summary: In Ashenvale, weavers seek the natural magic in laughing sisters' hair. Kil'hala at the Crossroads uses the locks to make enchanted robes.

sections.title: A Rare Weaving Component
sections.body:
Near Raynewood Retreat, laughing sisters are dryads whose hair holds natural magic. They guard the woods and are linked to Cenarius and the night elves. Horde craftsmen prize their hair as a potent material.

Kil'hala, a troll tailor at the Crossroads, spins the locks into enchanted robes for Deino's promising pupils of the arcane.

faq.q: Where does Laughing Sister's Hair come from?
aliases: where to get laughing sisters hair
faq.answer: Laughing sisters are dryads who wander the enchanted groves near Raynewood Retreat in central Ashenvale. Their hair holds natural magic.

faq.q: Why is Kil'hala looking for dryad hair?
faq.answer: Kil'hala, a tailor at the Crossroads in the Barrens, weaves the magical strands into enchanted cloth robes for Deino's promising pupils.

faq.q: Will the laughing sisters give up their hair willingly?
aliases: can you ask dryads for hair
faq.answer: No. Laughing sisters guard nature and protect Ashenvale. As Kil'hala notes, dryads would never willingly surrender their hair to agents of the Horde.

angles.text: As a tailor, you can use dryad locks as an exotic thread to bind nature magic into cloth.
As a member of the Horde, you must enter night elf territory in Ashenvale and slay woodland spirits for their locks. You take the local magic by force.
